metadata.title: User Management
metadata.description: Manage accounts, their roles and sessions, and see who has bought.

title: User Management
description: Manage accounts, their roles and sessions, and see who has bought.

banDialog.description: {name} is signed out everywhere and cannot sign in until you unban them.
banDialog.title: Ban user?

createDialog.description: Create an account with a starting password. The user confirms their email address the first time they sign in.
createDialog.name: Name
createDialog.title: Add user

deleteDialog.description: Permanently delete {name} and their account data. A licence they hold stops working and is kept with the payment records, no longer linked to them. This cannot be undone.
deleteDialog.title: Delete user?

feedback.impersonateSuccess: You are now signed in as {name}.

revokeAllDialog.description: {name} is signed out on every device and has to sign in again.
revokeAllDialog.title: Revoke all sessions?

invitations.title: Open invitations
invitations.description: Invitations nobody has accepted yet. Resend one to send a new link, or revoke it.
invitations.empty: No open invitations. Invite someone to give them an account with a role.

dialog.title: Invite a user
dialog.description: We email them a link to create their account with this role. The link works for {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} and only once.

revokeDialog.title: Revoke this invitation?
revokeDialog.description: The link sent to {email} stops working. You can invite them again later.

feedback.conflict: That address already has an account or an open invitation.
feedback.resent: A new link was sent to {email}.
